caption: The RefineryLens administration console
say: This is the RefineryLens administration console, where the team keeps the marketplace, the everyday pages and the money running. Everything here is demo data.

caption: Sixteen tools in seven groups, with counts where work is waiting
say: Sixteen tools sit in seven groups down the side, from people and the trade hub to money and system health. A number means work is waiting.

caption: Overview: key numbers and 14-day trends
say: The overview shows the key numbers: accounts, verified businesses, gas orders, drivers sharing right now, station reports and revenue, with fourteen-day trends.

caption: Needs attention: every queue in one list
say: Needs attention gathers every queue in one place. Let's work through it.

caption: Flagged content: people flagged a station report as made up
say: Two people flagged a station report as made up, and someone flagged a place listed twice. Each flag shows the reason, the note, and who sent it.

caption: Hide the report; the flags close as actioned
say: We hide the report. The flags close, and the decision goes in the audit log.

caption: Stations & shops: merge a duplicate so its reports count together
say: In stations and shops, the duplicate is merged into the real station. Its reports move across, and the copy disappears from public view.

caption: Price watch: a petrol price 58% above the Lagos median
say: Price watch lists reports far from their state's median. A petrol price fifty-eight percent above Lagos is almost certainly a typing mistake, so we hide it before it misleads anyone.

caption: Gas orders: a seller has not answered for three hours
say: This gas order has waited three hours for the seller. We cancel it with a reason, and the customer and the seller are both told why.

caption: Live trips: a driver's phone went silent
say: In live trips, a driver's phone went quiet forty-five minutes ago. We end the trip. Exact positions are never shown here.

caption: Verification: check the CAC number and licences, then verify
say: A business is waiting for verification. After checking its CAC number and licences, we verify it, and it gets the verified badge.

caption: Users: search, filter, and open anyone's account
say: In users, search by name, email or phone, and filter by kind, role, plan or state.

caption: Change role or plan, stop reporting, sign out everywhere
say: A person's page lets us change their role or plan, stop them reporting, or sign them out on every device. It shows their orders, reports and payments, but never their private files or messages.

caption: Businesses: suspend, reinstate, grant the Business plan
say: Businesses can be filtered to those delivering gas to homes. From here we suspend, reinstate, or grant thirty days of the Business plan.

caption: Listings and delivery jobs: take down or cancel, with a reason
say: Listings and delivery jobs can be taken down or cancelled, always with a reason the business is told.

caption: Payments & plans: revenue by month and plans ending soon
say: Payments show revenue by month, failed card payments, and Business plans ending soon, which we can extend with one click.

caption: Broadcast: count a group, then send an alert and push notification
say: Broadcast counts a group first, here households in Lagos, then sends an in-app alert and a push notification. Never by SMS, and only to the number we confirmed.

caption: Health & jobs: integrations and failed jobs with retry
say: Health and jobs shows which services are connected, and lets us retry failed background jobs.

caption: Audit log: every action we just took, recorded
say: The audit log records every action. Filtering on admin shows everything we just did.

caption: Exports: CSV downloads without addresses or phone numbers
say: And exports give CSV files for reporting and the price index, without addresses or phone numbers. Every download is logged.

caption: RefineryLens administration: every queue, every tool, every action on record
say: The RefineryLens administration console. Every queue, every tool, and every action on record.
